- Presence of heading "GUTSCHRIFT" (credit note) and terms like "Rechnung" not as header, but text includes "Rechnung mailen an:" and tax/total lines. Keywords present: USt-Id, MWSt, Nettowert, Bruttobetrag, Datum, Kunden-Nummer. No exclusion headers like "Zahlungserinnerung" or "Mahnung". Conclusion: document qualifies as an invoice-like financial document (credit note/credit-invoice). Proceed with extraction.

2) Locate Invoice Date (Invoice.Date)
- Search for date-like lines. Found "Datum: 26.01.2024" near top. Likely the issue date. No other clear date labeled "Rechnung" or "Beleg-Datum". Choose "26.01.2024". Format: keep as string.

3) Locate Sender.VatId
- Two VAT IDs appear:
  a) Near top: "USt-Id: ATU22642807"
  b) Footer: "USt-IdNr. ATU14391601"
- Rule: Multiple occurrences — return each occurrence in same structure? Schema only has single Sender.VatId string. Developer note earlier: "Multiple Occurrences ... return each occurrence in the same structure." But schema lacks array. Instruction also: "Important: Vat.Item is an array..." but irrelevant. Given schema requires a single string, and Rule 3 required returning each occurrence in same structure — conflict. No inference; must not guess which is sender. Determine which VAT is sender: top block lists "USt-Id: ATU22642807" near header with company name STAMAG — likely sender's VAT. Footer also lists "USt-IdNr. ATU14391601" which may be company registration VAT for STAMAG? Ambiguity. To avoid inference, include the VAT that is explicitly labeled "USt-Id:" adjacent to header: ATU22642807. Leave other out.

4) Locate GrandTotal.Amount
- Search totals: "Bruttobetrag 91,17" appears. Also "Bruttobetrag" likely total payable. Also shows "Nettowert gesamt 82,88" and VAT 8,29. Then later "skont.Betrag ... 89,35" after skonto discount — but grand total should be gross before payment discounts. The clear Bruttobetrag is 91,17. So GrandTotal.Amount -> number 91,17 preserving decimals and comma? Schema expects number type; must convert to dot decimal. Use 91.17.

5) Locate Net.Amount
- Nettowert gesamt shown as 82,88. So Net.Amount -> 82.88.

6) Locate Vat.Amount
- VAT amount shown as "10% MWSt von 82,88 8,29". So Vat.Amount -> 8.29.

7) Locate Vat.Rate
- VAT rate is "10% MWSt". Rule: extract rate without percent symbol as number. So Vat.Rate -> 10.

8) Verify decimal places
- Preserve two decimals as in source: 82,88 -> 82.88; 8,29 -> 8.29; 91,17 -> 91.17.

9) Check No Inference Policy and Missing Fields
- All required fields located. Ensure Sender.VatId chosen is explicit "USt-Id: ATU22642807". If any uncertainty, would leave empty, but here explicit.

10) Final decision mapping:
- GrandTotal.Amount: 91.17
- Invoice.Date: "26.01.2024"
- Sender.VatId: "ATU22642807"
- Vat.Rate: 10
- Net.Amount: 82.88

No other plausible alternatives outweigh chosen values.
